outcome_summary: Implemented the Stations View screen by enabling the disabled Stations tab in SaveDataViewer and creating StationsView.tsx — a paginated, filterable list following the OwnedShipsView pattern. WP-002 schema verification confirmed all 9 assumed field names, discovered the optional ships[] field, and established that the class field is always empty (driving the decision to use macro for the Type column). All 12 acceptance criteria were met with zero regressions across TypeScript compilation and Vitest suite (7/7 tests). Manifest documents (detail-screens.md, data-flows.md, file-tree.md, constraints.md) were fully updated.
